analysis: One reviewed case contained a duplicated dog placed in a semantically unrelated area of the same image, producing an implausible spatial arrangement. Although the manipulation was noticeable to a human reviewer, its irregular object boundaries, scale, and surrounding texture make precise localization challenging. This case illustrates why quantitative detection metrics should be supported by qualitative failure analysis.
scope_limit: This observation represents one manually reviewed qualitative case and does not describe every detection error.
